_meta.role: Perception Deployment Engineer - Model Deployment & Optimization

summary: M.S. Computer Engineering graduate from Rochester Institute of Technology. Cut TinyLlama 1.1B LLM GPU memory ~55% with 8-bit quantization at <1% accuracy loss, trained a quantization-aware model to 97.43% integer-only accuracy, and sped up YOLO 5.2× with TensorRT on Jetson. Wrote custom CUDA C++ kernels and fine-tuned transformers in PyTorch.

experience.title: AI/ML Intern
bullets: Improved validation accuracy of a fine-tuned DONUT (OCR-free visual document understanding transformer) from 55% to 93% on a custom medical billing dataset through improved preprocessing and model tuning.
Built PyTorch training pipelines with the HuggingFace VisionEncoderDecoder API; added special tokens and resized the decoder embedding layer.

experience.title: Deep Learning Intern
bullets: Trained YOLOv8n on 1,133 annotated images to 83% mAP@50 on held-out validation; exported to ONNX and TFLite for mobile deployment.

projects.name: SLM Compression and Benchmarking for Edge Deployment
bullets: Reduced GPU memory footprint by ~55% via 8-bit quantization (bitsandbytes LLM.int8()) on TinyLlama 1.1B LLM, with <1% accuracy degradation and +0.09 perplexity across HellaSwag, GSM8K, and ARC.
Ran latency benchmarking of peak VRAM and inference latency across prompt types with pynvml and psutil.

projects.name: Quantization-Aware Training for Integer-Only Inference
bullets: Implemented quantization-aware training (QAT) in PyTorch for a bias-free 256-64-10 MLP using straight-through-estimator fake quantization, int8 per-layer symmetric weights, and uint8 activations; integer-only inference reaches 97.43% on the 10,000-image MNIST test set at 16×16.

Calibrated the hidden-activation scale with an EMA observer and froze it for the final 25% of training so weights adapt to the deployed scale; folded it into a fixed-point requantization multiplier and shift.
Built a pure-integer reference model and exported int8 weights, scales, and 100 golden test vectors; fixed-point requantization matches the float reference on 99.996% of hidden values.

projects.name: GPT-2 Style Language Model from Scratch
bullets: Implemented a GPT-2 style Transformer from scratch in PyTorch: multi-head self-attention, MLP blocks, residual connections, layer norm, and weight tying.
Built a TikToken-based tokenizer wrapper and custom training loop with early stopping and perplexity evaluation.

projects.name: CUDA Kernel Optimization for VGG16 Inference
bullets: Replaced TorchScript conv layers in VGG16 with custom CUDA C++ kernels using memory coalescing, constant memory, and preallocated global buffers; coalesced kernel ran 49.2 ms vs 73.3 ms uncoalesced and 77.5 ms CPU TorchScript (~35% faster than naive GPU) with identical classification accuracy.

projects.name: Voice-Controlled Robotic Arm (COFFIN) — MS Capstone, RIT
bullets: Integrated TensorRT-optimized YOLO for visual servoing on Jetson: 5.2× speedup (56.7→10.9 ms, 17.6→92 FPS) over eager PyTorch, within a Flutter, Flask-SocketIO, and Jetson+Arduino voice-controlled pick-and-place pipeline; 100% pick reliability (10/10 trials).
